content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the handling of concurrent compaction requests, specifically when multiple compactions were initiated simultaneously with overlapping configurations (i.e., iterators). The previous implementation allowed for one compaction request to succeed while others would fail if they passed iterators, without appropriately managing the conflicts introduced. This issue led to errors when trying to run concurrent compactions. The patch addresses this by ensuring that compaction requests verify not only iterator configurations but also compaction strategies being used, preventing multiple concurrent requests from conflicting with each other.
